cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: I Told You Enough
cards.instruction: Agree to be honest while repeatedly narrowing what honesty requires and which details count.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. I'll be honest about your missing donation box. You asked where I went; I said the bank.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did you take the box there?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Yes. You didn't ask what was inside.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Was the money still in it when you arrived?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: At the car park, yes. If you mean the counter, that's a different arrival.

mechanism: A uses its pupil precise-question training to narrow what its honesty commits it to, treating missing qualifiers as B error.
confusable: Not simply denying wrongdoing: A agrees to answer but repeatedly excludes contents or location from the question just asked.
comparison: Donation-box destination versus birthday timeline definitions.
seedUse: D143 bank/box/money/car park/counter; S05 taught exact question wording.
